body:
## Code Review

This pull request introduces a script and test suite to build a conservative misconception and attempt-error semantic layer along with its associated JSON and Markdown artifacts. The implementation enforces strict safety rules, such as preventing single attempt-error signals from becoming definitive diagnoses and categorically excluding blocked or quarantined candidates. Feedback on the pull request suggests optimizing the `hasStrongEvidence` function by extracting inline array lookups into static `Set` constants to avoid recreating arrays on every invocation and reduce linear scan complexity.
